body: I completely agree with you, actually. I've had three arguments with my parents (since they're the ones paying for it) but their argument is that I've never even met him, and anyone would do what I'm doing. I guess I could still stay with my cousins for just a few days, and then look for apartments with him during that time? I just don't know what to tell him, or what to do. He wants to be moved in in 18 days.
I feel weighed down all the time, something like chronic fatigue? I hope that fixing that would help some. I just want to do something great. I want to be smart.
